evidence_required: Written pilot scope and participating-school approval
Documented lawful basis, privacy notice and data-processing responsibilities
Approved user roles, least-privilege access and access-review procedure
Documented retention, deletion and backup arrangements
Named staff responsible for reviewing and challenging warnings
Written prohibition on using predictions alone for promotion, punishment or exclusion
Evaluation plan for relevant groups with suitable sample-size and uncertainty checks
Pre-agreed accuracy, calibration, false-positive and false-negative monitoring measures
Documented support actions, responsible staff and follow-up recording
Documented correction, complaint, appeal and incident-response process
Tested procedure to suspend pilot predictions and return to normal school processes
Evidence that pilot staff understand limitations and responsible use
Written acceptance thresholds, review date and named approval authority
